title: CircuitBreakerState
description: Valkey value for cb:{agent_name} key (BEHAV-02). Tracks circuit breaker state per specialist agent. gsd-executor-general is exempt.

state.description: closed: agent operating normally. open: 3+ consecutive failures, routing to gsd-executor-general. half_open: TTL expired, next task is a probe.

failures.description: Number of consecutive failures since last success. Reset to 0 on success.

last_failure.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent failure. Used to compute half-open window (60s TTL).
